carbohydrates.importance: Easily digestible complex carbs provide steady energy without spiking blood sugar, helping prevent hypoglycemia.

fiber.importance: Promotes healthy digestion and prevents anal gland issues.

feeding_guidelines_and_tips.hypoglycemia_prevention: Yorkie puppies are extremely prone to low blood sugar. Always keep Nutri-Cal or Karo syrup on hand, and ensure they eat frequent small meals.
feeding_guidelines_and_tips.kibble_size: Choose extra-small (toy breed) kibble sizes to accommodate tiny jaws and encourage proper chewing to reduce tartar buildup.
feeding_guidelines_and_tips.treat_limit: Treats should comprise no more than 10% of their daily caloric intake to prevent nutritional imbalances and obesity.
feeding_guidelines_and_tips.hydration_tip: Fresh, clean water must be accessible at all times in shallow, stable bowls.
